name: Parallel
desc: Web research APIs for AI: search, extract, multi-hop research tasks, entity discovery (FindAll), and web monitoring.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the web with natural-language objectives. Returns LLM-optimized excerpts with citations.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Extract clean, citation-aware content from specific web URLs. Up to 20 URLs per request.

actions.name: create_task_run
actions.description: Initiate a Parallel research task. Returns immediately with a queued run; use Get Task Run Result to wait for completion.

actions.name: get_task_run
actions.description: Retrieve the current status of a task run by its ID.

actions.name: get_task_run_result
actions.description: Retrieve a task run result by run ID. Blocks until the run completes (or until the timeout is reached).

actions.name: create_findall_run
actions.description: Discover and verify entities matching plain-language criteria. Match conditions can be supplied directly or auto-generated from the objective.

actions.name: get_findall_result
actions.description: Return the current snapshot of matched candidates for a FindAll run, including any enrichment fields.

actions.name: chat_completion
actions.description: Get a chat completion using a Parallel processor. OpenAI-compatible interface; processor names like 'speed', 'base', 'core', 'pro', 'ultra' map to Parallel tiers.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
